page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left page with running text in one column, with a narrow sliver of the right page (right margin/column edge showing fragments of another column of text, partly cut off) at the far right. Left page: running head "ARITHMETICÆ" at top with page number "154" at left; text continues from previous page, then a diagram of computations, a numbered paragraph, further text, a second small table of numbers, and a final paragraph ending with a catchword-like line. Right page: partial text fragments in a narrow column at right edge, with a woodcut initial.

main_text.p: tionum terminis, 1.1.1. & 7 sumo: tum'q; compositam proportionem facio sic:
Vnde concludo hic mistos esse cantharos, primùm 210 pretij 12, deinde reliquorum singulorum generum 30.

4. Pharmacopolæ piper, saccarum, cinnamu & Zingiber ad quingentas uncias miscendæ sunt. Vncia piperis valet 25, saccari 24, cinnami 22, Zingiberis 18. Deniq; uncia aromatis misti futura est pretij 23: Quot unciæ piperis, quot saccari, quot reliquorum generum unciæ hic miscebuntur?
Hic primùm totus e simplicium mensurarum numeris datus est 500. Itaq; alternatis differentijs, ut uides:
Totum e differentijs, nempe 9, pro primo proportionis termino, pro secundo 500, pro antecedentibus reliquarum

page.notes: Right page fragments are cut off and too incomplete to transcribe reliably. Several figures in the diagrams are uncertain due to scan quality; the table columns were read as printed. The running head and page number are at the top left.
